description: Search the Socrata discovery catalogue open data catalogue (all Socrata-powered portals across North American cities and states) for datasets by keyword, e.g. query "traffic": dataset titles, descriptions, publisher and links. Dataset discovery — dataset records themselves are downloaded from the portal; results link back to it. Source: Socrata discovery catalogue. License: open-licence portals only — each dataset remains under its publishing portal's open licence.

query.description: Search term for this source (see the tool description for what it expects).

name: opendata__socrata_catalog_search
